# DropdownButton

Header: `winui/ui/input/DropdownButton.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/DropdownButton.hpp`.

A [Button](button.md#uibutton) with a trailing chevron that says a click opens a menu or flyout.

It adds no behavior of its own to [Button](button.md#uibutton): the flyout is whichever [FlyoutBase](flyout.md#class-flyoutbase) (a [MenuFlyout](menu-flyout.md#uimenuflyout), a [Flyout](flyout.md#uiflyout)) has it as its anchor, and a click opens that flyout as it would for any button. It adds a 12x12 animated chevron 8 DIPs right of the content, which dips on a press, and the ExpandCollapse automation pattern, expanded while the flyout is open. All of [Button](button.md#uibutton)'s API (text, content, style, on_click, command) applies.

Example: 
```cpp
// Declarative: the flyout owns its anchor.
window.set_content(ui::MenuFlyout{
    .items     = {{.text = "Send"}, {.text = "Reply"}, {.text = "Reply All", .on_click = [] { /* ... */ }}},
    .placement = ui::PopupPlacement::Below,
    .placement_alignment = ui::PopupPlacementAlignment::Leading,
    .anchor              = ui::DropdownButton{.text = "Email"},
});

// Imperative: the same tree built by hand.
auto  stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto* menu  = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::MenuFlyoutControl>());
menu->set_items({{.text = "Send"}, {.text = "Reply"}, {.text = "Reply All"}});
menu->set_placement(ui::PopupPlacement::Below);
menu->set_placement_alignment(ui::PopupPlacementAlignment::Leading);
ui::DropdownButtonControl* email = menu->set_anchor(std::make_unique<ui::DropdownButtonControl>("Email"));
```

## `ui::DropdownButton`

A button with a chevron that says it opens a flyout. Builds a [ui::DropdownButtonControl](#uidropdownbuttoncontrol).

The button does not hold the flyout itself: it is the `.anchor` of a [ui::MenuFlyout](menu-flyout.md#uimenuflyout) or [ui::Flyout](flyout.md#uiflyout), and a click opens that.

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::MenuFlyout{
    .items     = {{.text = "Send"}, {.text = "Reply"}, {.text = "Reply All"}},
    .placement = ui::PopupPlacement::Below,
    .placement_alignment = ui::PopupPlacementAlignment::Leading,
    .anchor              = ui::DropdownButton{.text = "Email"},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::DropdownButton{
    .text, .variant, .padding, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height,
    .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip,
    .enabled, .accessibility, .command, .command_parameter, .on_click, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-text"></span>`text` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The label before the chevron, ignored while [`.content`](#uidropdownbutton-content) is set. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-variant"></span>`variant` | `ui::Binding<ui::ButtonVariant>` | `{ui::ButtonVariant::Neutral}` | The button look, as [ui::Button](button.md#uibutton)'s. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-padding"></span>`padding` | `ui::Binding<std::optional<ui::Thickness>>` |  | Padding around the label or content; nullopt keeps the theme's button padding. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-command"></span>`command` | `ui::CommandRef` |  | As [ui::Button](button.md#uibutton)'s: run after [`.on_click`](#uidropdownbutton-on_click), and the button enabled only while it is. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-command_parameter"></span>`command_parameter` | `std::string` |  | Handed to [`.command`](#uidropdownbutton-command) when it runs. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_click"></span>`on_click` | `ui::Action` |  | A click; [`.command`](#uidropdownbutton-command) runs after it. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::DropdownButton>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uidropdownbutton-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | Arbitrary content (an icon, say) before the chevron, instead of [`.text`](#uidropdownbutton-text). |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

It adds no behavior of its own to [Button](button.md#uibutton): the flyout is whichever [FlyoutBase](flyout.md#class-flyoutbase) (a [MenuFlyout](menu-flyout.md#uimenuflyout), a [Flyout](flyout.md#uiflyout)) has it as its anchor, and a click opens that flyout as it would for any button.
```cpp
DropdownButtonControl()
```

A button with no text; give it content through [Button](button.md#uibutton)'s setters.

```cpp

```

A button labeled [`text`](button.md#text), with the chevron after it.

```cpp
~DropdownButtonControl() override
```

### is_flyout_open

```cpp
bool is_flyout_open() const
```

Whether the flyout the button opens is showing. False when no flyout has this button as its anchor.

### chevron

```cpp
AnimatedIconControl* chevron() const
```

The chevron (an [AnimatedIcon](animated-icon.md#uianimatedicon)), for an app that wants another source. Owned by the button. Its state ("Normal", "PointerOver" or "Pressed") follows the button's.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

The same answer as [ButtonControl](button.md#uibuttoncontrol)'s, since the chevron measures only its glyph.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

[Button](button.md#uibutton)'s size, at least as tall as the chevron plus the padding.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places the content as [Button](button.md#uibutton) does and the chevron at the right edge of the padded area, centered vertically.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the button, then the chevron in the theme's secondary text color at rest and its tertiary one under the pointer and while pressed. Disabled, on an Accent button and in themes without those colors, the chevron takes the label's color.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

[Button](button.md#uibutton)'s pointer handling, then moves the chevron to the new visual state.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances [Button](button.md#uibutton)'s animations and the chevron's, catching state changes without an event ([set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled), focus loss).

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

[Button](button.md#uibutton)'s keys (Enter or Space click on key up), then moves the chevron to the new state.

### automation_providers

```cpp
void automation_providers(AutomationProviders& out) override
```

Lists what a client can do with this node: set `out`'s field for each pattern this control implements now to `this`, through the provider interface it inherits privately (ui/Automation.hpp). A pattern that only applies in some states is an `if`. `out` arrives empty, and nothing is listed by default.

Example: 
```cpp
class Chip final : public ui::Element, private ui::InvokeProvider
{
protected:
    void automation_providers(ui::AutomationProviders& out) override
    {
        out.invoke = this;
    }

private:
    bool invoke() override
    {
        on_click_();
        return true;
    }
    ui::Callback<void()> on_click_;
};
```
